regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and Supporting Information statement
regions.finding: Article identity and the aggregate NHC-promoted allenal/chalcone annulation claim were inspected. The page advertises Supporting Information, but workspace association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

The upper aldehyde/enal transformations are cited prior NHC chemistry and are classified as one literature overview. The lower S9→S10→S11 route is explicitly hypothetical and is classified as mechanism; its question marks and unobserved S11 product are preserved.

The prose reports the same run as Table 1 entry 1: 13 mol% IMes·HCl/27 mol% t-BuOK in THF at room temperature, 3aa in 20% NMR yield, an unidentified product 4aa, 55% recovered 2a, and expected P1 not formed. It is linked to the page-2 row rather than duplicated.

unresolved: The prior-work and hypothetical Scheme 1 structures contain generic substituents and no experiment-level quantities or yields.
The identity and yield of 4aa are not reported.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1, reaction header, entries 1–5, and footnotes
regions.finding: Five optimization conditions were read row-by-row with x, t1/t2, time, NMR yield, 2a recovery, shared 0.4 M header, and catalyst/base loading overrides. Entry 5 is merged with Table 2 entry 1 and Table 4 entry 2 because all printed conditions and outcomes coincide.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left DNPH arrow and Figure 1
regions.finding: A distinct current-paper condensation of 3aa with 1 equiv DNPH and 26 equiv H2SO4 in EtOH/H2O 2.3:1 at room temperature for 5 h gives hydrazone 5 in 92%. ORTEP characterization is not a second preparation.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Scheme 2 and mechanism prose
regions.finding: Paths a–c through proposed intermediates A–I were classified as a single mechanism record; no intermediate is treated as an isolated experiment.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Table 2, entries 1–14, and footnotes
regions.finding: Fourteen concentration/loading conditions were inspected independently. Entry 1 is merged with Table 1 entry 5/Table 4 entry 2, while entry 10 is merged with Table 3 entry 1/Table 4 entry 1. Entries 12 and 13 retain the explicit 10 and 5 mol% catalyst/base loadings.

unresolved: Tables 1–2 do not report workup, purification, isolated masses, or most THF volumes.
The DNPH experiment omits scale, solvent volumes, workup, mass, and yield basis.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 3, entries 1–7, and footnotes
regions.finding: Seven base/solvent conditions were inspected. Entry 1 is the same optimized run as Table 2 entry 10/Table 4 entry 1; entries 2–7 remain distinct. Explicit zero yields, two-component recoveries, base/solvent identities, times, and the two 1.5 mL solvent portions were retained.

Thirteen independent substrate-scope experiments were retained: 3aa–3ag, 3ba/3bh/3bi, 3cj, 3da, and one 3ek reaction giving two relative stereoisomers. Printed isolated yields, 0.96 g mass for 3aa, 1:2.6 dr for 3da, and 1:3.1 relative-stereoisomer ratio for 3ek were kept product-specific; no yield was invented for 3ek.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Table 4, entries 1–5, and footnotes
regions.finding: Five controls were inspected. Entries 1–2 are cross-listed optimized runs and were merged with their matching table records. Entries 3–5 remain distinct omission controls, including explicit 11% product without IMes·HCl and explicit 0% yields without t-BuOK or without both additives.

regions.region: page 3 conclusion and Associated Content statement
regions.finding: Conclusion adds no new experiment. The SI availability statement does not establish a supplied/associated SI file, so no SI-only procedure or characterization fact was inferred.

unresolved: Table 3's footnote names THF/t-BuOK while rows substitute base or solvent; row labels are retained, but exact portion assignment for non-THF rows remains source-reviewable.
Scheme 3 omits reaction times and most scales/operations; 3ek has no printed yield or ratio basis.

regions.finding: B. Miao is thanked for reproducing preparations of 3ac, 3ag, and 3bh. No independent quantities, conditions, yields, or run identifiers are given, so the statement is linked to existing scope records and creates no duplicate experiments.
Bibliography/prior-literature citations only; external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 4 footnote 5 crystal data for 5 and CCDC 1002355
regions.finding: Crystallographic data characterize hydrazone 5 from the page-2 DNPH experiment. The deposition is not a reaction, not an associated SI file, and does not verify a machine structure encoding.

regions.region: page 4 footnotes 11–12 crystal data for (R*,R*)-3ek and (S*,R*)-3ek
regions.finding: CCDC 1014779/1014780 support the two source stereoisomer assignments in the existing Scheme 3 3ek record; they are characterization rather than separate preparations.

unresolved: Acknowledged reproductions lack separable run details.
CCDC depositions do not establish SI association or certify machine SMILES.
No new preparative operation appears on page 4.
